Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be preformed every 
4000workinh hours as indicated by H4000 in the title block.

The 
motor of the pump: type ANVE - WT 001, Teco Electric & Machinery Co. LTD Taiwan

The first draft initiated by eng. Emad Khames, reviewed by eng. Medhat 
 El-Damaty, tested by eng. Mohamed Alkhateb Mohamed Salem, accepted by eng. Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Hassan Zayed, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any 
 maintenance procedure

Work to be Carried Out

Check the (teeth, grease, 
gear seals, sealing faces) coupling and alignment coupling (air gap:40 
(tolerance +2,-5)mm, radial:0.56, axial 0.22)

Verify and check the 
oil (viscosity, acid No. & contamination) for motor upper bearing (oil 
approximate 60 L oil - mobil oil heavy medium - ISO-VO 68) and change if 
required

Verification and check the 
oil (viscosity acid No. & contamination) for pump thrust bearing (oil 
approximate 40 L oil - mobil DTE light -ISO-VG 32) and change if required

Verification of the grease 
mobilux 3 (140g) for lower bearing of motor and change if required

Check the tighten of all 
bolts for the pump and motor

Clean the cooling water 
pipes of thrust bearings (pump and motor)

Check the goodness of 
inlet outlet sealing water drain and vent valves

General cleaning for the 
external pump

Check the packing (6pieces 
- IOmm - LATT, YFLON 4788) lantern ring shaft protecting sleeve and change if 
required

Check the cooling for the 
packing
